ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within the circle $ \odot O$, $AB = AC$. If $\angle ABC = 65^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=AC$, \\
hence $\angle ABC=\angle ACB=65^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle A=180^\circ-2\angle ABC=180^\circ-2\times65^\circ=50^\circ$, \\
since $\overset{\frown}{BC}=\overset{\frown}{BC}$, \\
thus $\angle BOC=2\angle A=2\times50^\circ=\boxed{100^\circ}$.
